name: When is the right time to add a pantry to your kitchen layout?

mainEntity.name: When is the right time to add a pantry to your kitchen layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider adding a pantry when your current countertops remain cluttered and kitchen base cabinets can no longer store dry goods and small appliances efficiently. A dedicated pantry is also worth planning if you are already undertaking a complete kitchen remodel or reconfiguring an open-concept floor plan. Bundling a pantry addition into a broader kitchen renovation allows you to match cabinetry finishes, coordinate electrical updates, and adjust wall layouts in a single, well-managed construction phase rather than performing disruptive standalone updates later.
acceptedAnswer.description: The ideal time is when countertops lack storage for dry goods and small appliances, or during a full kitchen remodel when walls and layouts are already being updated.
